Batch scrape with aggressive preprocessing configuration

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val engineConfig = mapper.readValue("{\"content\":{\"preprocessing_preset\":\"aggressive\"},\"ssrf\":{}}", CrawlConfig::class.java)
    val engine = Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig)
    val urls = listOf<String>("https://example.com/article1", "https://example.com/article2")
    val result = Crawlberg.batchScrape(engine, urls)
    println(result.completedCount)
    println(result.failedCount)
    println(result.totalCount)
}
```
